newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Pemex reports avg June crude exports.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Pemex reports avg June crude exports.

text.p: Mexico's state oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said in a statement on Tuesday it exported an average 1.703 million barrels per day (bpd) of crude in June.
Exports for the month fell from June 1996, when exports were an average 1.714 million bpd. Last month's exports rose from May's 1.664 million bpd.
Pemex said its average exports for the first six months of the year were 1.671 million bpd.
Mexico has gradually boosted its exports this year, with greater trade of heavy crude Maya.
